into *calm, clear* interfaces.
hero.lead: A UI/UX designer with a Master's degree in Computer Science. I pair user research with analytical thinking and a QA-trained eye for detail to design digital products people understand at first glance.
hero.badge: UI/UX Design · User Research · Prototyping · Design Systems ·

about.title: A designer's eye, an *engineer's* mind.
about.p1: I'm a motivated professional with a Master's degree in Computer Science and a clear focus on UI/UX design. I work hands-on in Figma, follow a user-centered design process from wireframe to prototype, and have first experience in cloud design.
about.p2: Two years in quality control taught me to notice what users notice: the inconsistent spacing, the broken breakpoint, the step that takes one tap too many. Together with basic HTML and CSS, that makes me a designer who thinks about how things get built — analytical, detail-oriented, and motivated to create intuitive, user-friendly digital products.

items.role: Product Design Bootcamp — Doctor appointment app “Tebeto”
points: Delivered an end-to-end UI/UX and product design project for a digital medical booking platform, following the user-centered design process.
Ran UX research, competitive analysis and user interviews to identify user needs, pain points and opportunities.
Developed personas, user journeys, user flows and the information architecture for an intuitive experience.
Created low- and high-fidelity wireframes, interactive prototypes and high-fidelity UI designs in Figma.
Conducted usability tests, analysed user feedback and iterated on the designs.
Built a consistent design system with reusable UI components, applying visual hierarchy, typography, colour theory, accessibility and responsive design.
Designed user-centered features such as a waiting list, family profiles, document upload, chatbot support and gamification.
Quality assurance for WordPress templates with a focus on usability, visual consistency and functionality.
Reviewed responsive designs and carried out cross-browser testing.
Worked closely with developers to fix issues and improve the user experience.

items.title: Figma UI/UX Design Advanced
items.text: Design systems, responsive design, variables and design tokens, components and variants, interactive prototyping, microinteractions and accessibility.

items.title: Figma UX/UI Design Essentials
items.text: Wireframing, prototyping, UI components, layout, colour and typography, style guides and core UI/UX workflows.

case.title: A doctor appointment app for the *whole family.*
case.lead: Tebeto is more than a booking tool. It makes healthcare simpler with family member management, smart waiting lists, a helpful chatbot for doctor guidance, gamification rewards and digital document uploads — a smoother experience for both patients and doctors.
case.heroAlt: Collage of Tebeto hi-fi screens: home, family members, bookings, doctor profile and payment

overview.title: Project *overview*
goals: Gain market share in online medical bookings
Earn revenue through commission and service partnerships

problem.title: Problem & *solution*
problem.lead: Five frustrations kept coming up in research. Each one became a feature.

pairs.problem: **Managing appointments** for the whole family is difficult

pairs.solution: Real-time availability and a **waiting list system**

pairs.problem: Users struggle **to choose the right doctor** confidently
pairs.solution: **Chatbot guidance** to choose the right doctor

pairs.problem: **Paper documents are lost** or **forgotten** during visits
**No engagement** leads to missed reviews and appointments

process.title: Design *process*
process.lead: We applied a User-Centered Design (UCD) approach to prioritise the user and focus on their needs throughout every phase of the design process.

discover.title: *Discover*
discover.lead: By exploring behaviours and frustrations, we identified the core gaps in the existing appointment booking process, which later guided the feature direction for Tebeto.
discover.surveyLead: To better understand patient behaviours and booking challenges, we ran an online survey using **Porsline** as our distribution and data-collection tool. It helped us identify the key pain points.
discover.benchLead: We analysed leading competitors including **Paziresh24**, **Doctoreto** and **DrDr** to identify key features, gaps and opportunities in the online medical booking market. These insights helped define how Tebeto can deliver a more seamless and comprehensive appointment experience.
discover.personaLead: We created a persona based on our research insights, highlighting her lifestyle and personality, goals and motivations, frustrations and needs.

blocks.title: Goals & motivations
items: Book doctor appointments for herself and her family quickly, easily and reliably.
Avoid wasting time in clinic queues.
Receive accurate reminders so no appointment is forgotten.
Save and access visit history whenever needed.

blocks.title: Needs
items: Ability to manage the entire family under one account.

blocks.title: Background & lifestyle
items: Has limited time due to balancing full-time work and family duties.
Prefers doing essential tasks online to avoid unnecessary in-person delays.
Highly values her family's health; frequently needs to schedule appointments for her children and husband.
Has had bad experiences with online systems (failed reservations, missing confirmation messages), making her less trusting of digital platforms.

blocks.title: Pain points & challenges
items: Confirmation SMS sometimes doesn't arrive, causing stress and uncertainty.
Registration and login processes in some apps are long and confusing.
Booking separate appointments for each child takes a lot of time.
Often unsure whether an online reservation was actually completed, leading to unnecessary in-person visits.
Frequently forgets appointments due to ineffective reminder systems.

design.title: *Design*
design.wireLead: Early conceptual sketches outlining the app's structure, layout and user flow to validate ideas before high-fidelity design.
design.wireAlt: Six low-fidelity wireframes: home, booking appointment, doctor's profile, my bookings, login and my profile
design.hifiLead: The final interface: a calm blue palette, generous touch targets and one consistent component language across every flow.

features.title: Family profiles
features.text: Manage every family member under one account and book for each of them without starting over.

features.title: Smart waiting list
features.text: Real-time availability plus a waiting list, so limited slots no longer mean long queues and delays.

features.title: Tebot, the chatbot
features.text: Guided questions about symptoms help users choose the right doctor with confidence.

features.title: Digital documents
features.text: Upload and store medical documents in the app, so nothing is lost or forgotten at the visit.

features.title: Gamification
features.text: Points and rewards encourage reviews and showing up — boosting engagement and attendance.

style.title: Style *guide*
style.lead: A compact system that keeps every screen consistent: four colours, one type scale, a five-column grid and a small set of reusable components.
style.componentsAlt: Tab bar states, profile tabs, segmented controls, waitlist buttons, toggles, favourites and rating stars
style.iconsAlt: Icon set with medical specialty icons and interface icons

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.quote: By centering on user needs — clarity, control and connection — the Tebeto design created a more efficient and empathetic healthcare journey. The solution demonstrates how intentional design can alleviate patient anxiety, save time and foster trust, ultimately making essential care more accessible for everyone.
